## OpenAQ (ground stations)

Retrieved 2026-09-25T21:52:02+00:00 (1,862 API calls). Window 2015-01-01 to 2026-03-31.

- Indian locations in OpenAQ: **764**.
- Reference-monitor (non-mobile) locations with a PM2.5 or PM10 sensor: **640**; with at least one day of PM data in the window: **637**.
- After merging locations within 0.5 km into one site: **594** sites, **591** with data in the window.
- Low-cost (non-monitor) PM sensors excluded: 196 sensors at 121 locations.

Coverage comes from OpenAQ's daily rollup (`/sensors/{id}/days/monthly`). Months are local (IST) calendar months. A unit-month counts if any day has data; 'good' = at least 75% of days have data (informational only; the audit's completeness rules come in Phase 3). Where a unit has several sensors for one pollutant, the best-covered sensor that month is used.

## CPCB data repository (via third-party mirror)

Checked 2026-09-25T21:38:37+00:00. CPCB's own repository endpoints (`airquality.cpcb.gov.in/dataRepository/...`) return HTTP 404; the CCR web app is now an obfuscated bundle. The mirror `github.com/Vonter/india-cpcb-aqi` (ODbL 1.0) publishes yearly Parquet files of CPCB's 15-minute station data scraped from those endpoints (releases dated 2026-01-07). Only footers and the station-id column were read (2.4 MB).

Files are padded: every listed station has a row for every 15-minute slot, including slots with no measurement. So 'stations listed' overstates the network; the station-year equivalents (non-null PM rows / slots in the year) are the meaningful measure.
